'''Breyan ti Maclain Mandragoran''' was the wife of [[Lain Mandragoran]], mother of Isam ([[Slayer]]) and aunt of [[Lan Mandragoran]] from lost [[Malkier]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Breyan ti Malcain Mandragoran}}

==History==
Breyan was born to [[House Maclain]], and married into [[House Mandragoran]], the royal family, through her husband Lain, the younger brother of the king.{{ref|[[Origins of the Wheel of Time]], Revision 23 - Family Tree}}

Being urged by [[Cowin Gemallan]] she dares her husband Lain to travel into the [[Blight]]. He accepts this and unfortunately perishes while he is there. This weakens Malkier and [[Trollocs]] strike and completely destroy Malkier. She flees with her son Isam into the Blight.

Ultimately her fate is currently unknown.
